title: NLP Scientist
description_html:
About the role

Our research lab studies how large language models handle domain text.

What you'll do

  • Fine-tune transformers with PyTorch
  • Design evaluations of large language models
  • Publish results; technical writing matters

What you bring

  • A PhD in a related field
  • NLP
  • Python

Nice to have

  • Spark

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $120,000–$140,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
